# Quartus report fixture

Fitter summary, timing summary, and selected clock/Fmax tables captured from
the actual assembled OOC HYBRID01 build on November 16, 2026 using Quartus
25.1std.0 Lite and the 10M50DAF484C7G device. The `.sta.rpt` fixture retains only
the clock and Fmax tables used by the performance reader. Tests copy these
text fixtures into temporary builds and never invoke Quartus or a programmer.
